**Review: October subscription email (channel: email)**

The draft passes. Here is the claims list.

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Your subscription box left Bristol this morning" | Order and dispatch fact for this send. Bristol matches the policy (hand-packed in Bristol). Needs to be true on the day it sends. |
| "a smoky lapsang and a soft white peony" | Product facts and flavour descriptions, covered by the product team's sign-off |
| "you can pause or cancel any time from your account" | Allowlisted: "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" |

- **Superlatives, guarantees, health or green claims:** none.
- **Urgency:** none.
- **Invented numbers or testimonials:** none.
- **Banned words and constructions:** none. No "elevate", "unlock", "journey" or "indulge". No exclamation marks, rhetorical openers, or em-dash asides. The tone is warm, plain and unhurried.
- **Spelling:** no UK/US differences appear in the copy.
- **Disclosure:** none required. This is our own email, not a paid partnership, gifted product or affiliate link.

**One thing to check before sending:** the subject says "October tins", but today is 17 November 2026. If this goes out now, either the subject is a month out of date or the box is a late October shipment. "This month" and "next month" in the body would then be off too. If it is a normal November send, change the subject to "November". I haven't listed this as an issue because I can't tell the real send date from the draft. As per the policy, Sam still approves everything public.
